description: Get undated facts for one identified or named hotel: address, photos, descriptions, star classification, sourced guest ratings, consecutive positive review count, facilities, pet/parking policies and timezone. Optional fee amounts may be absent in the catalog. Accepts the exact HotelUse hotel_id from a previous result, or hotel_name and destination. A unique, confident match is required. A full hotel name may be used without a destination; add the destination when ambiguous. No stay dates, availability, live prices or room-level offers are included. Supply exactly one hotel_id or hotel_name. Omit unknown optional values; do not send null. Resolve a hotel follow-up by name or position against the most recent relevant ordered search list. Copy its hotel_id exactly; if unavailable, use hotel_name and destination. Ask only if the hotel is ambiguous. For room options or current room prices call get_room_rates directly, passing search_quote_session_id from that search to preserve its stay and preferences. The first get_room_rates response includes all returned room groups and every provider minimum in room_groups. For all room options and prices, use that complete list after one call; do not paginate raw supplier offers or re-query the same stay. The raw_offer_page count describes supplier rate plans, not additional room types. Users can expand room cards locally without another price query. For undated amenities, policies or other hotel facts call get_hotel directly. Do not repeat a destination search before either hotel-specific tool. Existing returned prices may be explained without refreshing when no new search or current quote is requested.

destination.description: City or region to disambiguate the hotel name.

hotel_id.description: Exact HotelUse hotel_id from a previous result.

hotel_name.description: Hotel name when no exact hotel_id is available. A unique, confident match is required. A full hotel name may be used without a destination; add the destination when ambiguous.

locale.description: Traveler BCP 47 language, such as en-GB, independent of the destination.

user_locale.description: Optional traveler locale from client context, such as en-GB. Independent of the hotel destination.

user_location_country.description: Optional traveler country from client context, used for default currency and residency. Independent of the hotel destination.

name: get_hotel
title: Hotel information
